# RDweeb | Commissions & Portfolio

> RDweeb makes music and sound, websites, video edits, image edits and games, and takes commissions for all of them. The site is a PSP / PS3 style menu (DWEEB//OS).

## What is offered
- Music and sound production (songs, producer tags, sound design)
- Website creation
- Video editing
- Image editing
- Game development
- Art commissions: coming soon

## Packages
- Standard: queued, $1 per asset, 3 free revisions, extra revisions $1+ each, credit to RDweeb required
- Premium: prioritized, $3 per asset, no credit required
- Payment only through Ko-fi. Robux accepted at $1 = 100 Robux.

## Pages
- https://rdweeb.xyz/ (everything is inside the menu)
